PluginInfo.description: One configured plugin as clients see it.

dropped_events.description: Events and bus notifications dropped because it fell behind.

has_settings.description:
The plugin declared a settings form (client protocol 1.81.0), which
`plugins.settings.get` returns.

hooks.description: The hooks it intercepts, in no particular order.

items.description: The name of a hook, as a snake-case label.

producer_messaging.description:
Its producer messaging is open: the plugin declares it and its
configuration enables it.

reason.description: Why the plugin failed or last disconnected, or what it could not do.

settings_missing.description: A required field of its settings form has no value.

stderr.description: What the plugin last wrote to standard error.

subscribe_events.description: The event types it subscribes to; empty for none.

items.description: Event types: a type, a prefix ending in `*`, or `*` for every type.

tools.description: The names its tools are declared under.

ui_path.description:
Where the daemon serves the plugin's pages, `/plugins/<name>/` with
the name percent-encoded, relative to the daemon's web page (client
protocol 1.80.0). Present while the plugin is connected and has
declared pages.

oneOf.description: The connection dropped and the daemon is restarting it.
Every start attempt failed; `plugins.restart` tries again.

description: The configured plugins, in the order their hooks run.
title: PluginsListResult
